title: The Cabinet
pun: The same four games stated as a screen instead of a chart -- phosphor glow, a glass bezel, scanlines. Emulia ships ten picture modes; this is the icon that admits the app is about a display.
reads_as: a small dark CRT with four glowing sprites on it
risk: Same 1.19px sprites as (a), and the scanlines are a 1.15dp feature that is gone below 96px. Dark ground with bright specks is also the shape most likely to read as a generic emulator icon.
